headline: The counter is back: VIPER PIT's CPU throws qcb at close range again
lede: #2151 restored the down-back counter the CPU lost in #1735 — all five fighters use it at close range, SABLE's ward walls off point-blank too, and new behavioural gates make the regression impossible to sleep through.

notes.text: VIPER PIT CPU special-attacks at close range (#2151): a real back-and-forth where the AI answers pressure with each fighter's signature counter, exactly the README's promise.
The fix sits next to the keep-away projectile branch, so both fighters' qcb tools now fire as designed; SABLE's ward punishes point-blank too.

Five new gates make the CPU prove it actually throws the counter (real sim, 8 seeds per fighter), plus a --mutate kill-probe that showed the gate goes red when the branch is dead — the reason #2151 stayed red on main since #1735.
IRON RING re-verified green (determinism unchanged). Main re-freezes on the nightly at 7f41097 (#2145 papersplay family + one new watchcheck resume line) — both recorded for the green path.
